## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users.

## Validation

List relevant checks and results. Clearly distinguish fixture tests from live Windows/hardware verification.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves existing snapshot/data compatibility, or documents a migration.
- [ ] I checked the affected behavior on Windows PowerShell 5.1.
- [ ] For UI changes, I checked both themes, keyboard access, resizing, and display scaling as relevant.
- [ ] Unknown/denied readings remain unknown rather than being treated as disabled.
- [ ] No personal reports, credentials, serial numbers, or private event-log data are included.
- [ ] No duplicate functions, declarations, or event handlers remain after refactoring.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.

## Dependencies, permissions, and risks

Describe new dependencies, elevation, network behavior, or limitations. Write N/A if none.
